prompt.text:
Implement a complete TypeScript source file exporting `Parcel`, `ParcelPatch`, and `ParcelLedger`.

`ParcelLedger` must provide `create(parcel)`, `get(id)`, `list()`, `update(id, patch)`, and `remove(id)`. Parcels contain `id`, `recipient`, `units`, and `massKg`. IDs and recipients must be nonblank and are not normalized. Units must be a nonnegative safe integer; mass must be finite and nonnegative. Duplicate IDs, unknown IDs for `get` or `update`, and malformed values throw `RangeError`. `remove` returns false for an unknown ID and true after removal.

An update may set any combination of recipient, units, and mass, including zero values; an empty patch is valid. Preserve creation order, including after updates. Copy all inputs and outputs so no caller can mutate stored records. The constructor accepts an optional readonly initial array and must apply the same validation and duplicate rules.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
